sn40.3:1.4: Idha bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati || sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti || Yan tam ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti || tatiyaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharati ||
sn40.3:1.6: So khvāham āvuso pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharāmi sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedemi || Yan tam ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharāmi ||
sn40.3:1.7: tassa mayham āvuso iminā vihārena viharato pītisahagatā saññā manasikārā samudācaranti || || 6
sn40.3:2.1: Atha kho mam āvuso Bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etad avoca || ||
sn40.3:2.3: mā brāhmaṇa tatiyaṃ jhānam pamādo tatiye jhāne cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi tatiye jhāne cittam ekodikarohi tatiye jhāne cittam samādahāti || || 7
sn40.3:2.4: So khvāhaṃ āvuso aparena samayena pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca vihāsiṃ sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedesiṃ || yan tam ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyaṃ jhānam upasampajja vihāsiṃ || || 8
sn40.3:2.5: Yaṃ hi tam āvuso sammāvadamāno vadeyya || pe || mahābhiññatam pattoti || || 3
